{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_orders.sum()}")

# Check the range of revenue to verify cleaning
print(f"Min revenue: {df['revenue_clean'].min():.2f}")
print(f"Max revenue: {df['revenue_clean'].max():.2f}")

# Check the status column
print(f"Unique statuses: {df['status'].unique().tolist()}")

# Filter to completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
